messages.author: bd00314644d53a96
messages.subject: siteCovs to detection in OccuMulti
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a small problem or question with the occuMulti function. I have been working on the  occurrence patterns of 3 species and I want to test if some covariates have any effect on the interaction or occupancy . All my covariates are "siteCovs", however, I also want to test if some of them influence detection: for example, the  camera trap model or the vegetation density . Here I leave the code that I have been using 

library(unmarked)
dim(Urci <- read.csv("data/registers/Ucinereoargenteus_5.csv")[-c(52,14),-1]) # Datos de lince:
dim(Lyru <- read.csv("data/registers/Lrufus_5.csv")[-c(52,14),-1])
# Datos de conejos:
dim(Syfl <- read.csv("data/registers/Sfloridanus_5.csv")[-c(52,14),-1])

y <- list(as.matrix(Urci),
          as.matrix(Lyru),
          as.matrix(Syfl))
# Indica los nombres de las especies:
names(y) <- c("zorra", "lince", "conejo")

covs <- read.csv("data/covs/std_covs110120.csv")
chp3 <- unmarkedFrameOccuMulti(y = y, # lista de historias de detección
                               siteCovs = covs[-c(52,14),] # covariables de sitio
                               ,obsCovs = NULL)

All good here. Now I begin to adjust the detection models with the vegetation density  measured for each sampling station (it is a continuous variable) 

str(covs$DenVeg)
##  num [1:67] -0.822 -0.725 -0.356 0.283 -0.119 ...
These are the formulas for each component 
formupsi1 <- c("~1","~1","~1","~0","~0","~0","~0")
formup1 <- c("~1","~1","~1")
formup2 <- c("~DenVeg","~DenVeg","~DenVeg")
summary(m0 <- occuMulti(formup1, formupsi1, data = chp3))
## 
## Call:
## occuMulti(detformulas = formup1, stateformulas = formupsi1, data = chp3)
## 
## Occupancy (logit-scale):
##                      Estimate    SE      z P(>|z|)
## [zorra] (Intercept)    -0.138 0.259 -0.535   0.593
## [lince] (Intercept)    -0.136 0.363 -0.375   0.708
## [conejo] (Intercept)   -0.131 0.251 -0.522   0.602
## 
## Detection (logit-scale):
##                      Estimate     SE      z  P(>|z|)
## [zorra] (Intercept)    -1.363 0.1117 -12.20 3.04e-34
## [lince] (Intercept)    -2.490 0.2161 -11.53 9.85e-31
## [conejo] (Intercept)   -0.774 0.0914  -8.47 2.55e-17
## 
## AIC: 1770.762 
## Number of sites: 65
## optim convergence code: 0
## optim iterations: 34 
## Bootstrap iterations: 0

In the model without covariates everything is fine. But when I include the vegetation density (DenVeg) in the detection I have this error. 

summary(m1 <- occuMulti(formup2, formupsi1, data = chp3))

Error in eval(predvars, data, env) : object 'DenVeg' not found

I was testing with the package example and the same thing happens for the simulated data: if I include a site variable in the detection formula I get the same error. Am I doing something wrong? or does OccuMulti only receive observation variables in the detection component?
If so, what would be the implication  of constructing a matrix of MxJ where I repeat my covariate of ´DenVeg´ in each period J, and thus deceive the function?

Thank you very much for the help you can give me: D  

--
Gabriel Andrade Ponce
Biólogo
Estudiante de Doctorado en Ciencias
Instituto de Ecología A.C.
Xalapa, Veracruz

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: siteCovs to detection in OccuMulti
parts:
Hi Gabriel,

You are correct, at the moment occuMulti doesn't allow site covs to be used directly in detection formulas. That's something I should add. You're also correct that the workaround is to replicate the site covariate J times for each site and put it in the obs covs. That's exactly what other unmarked functions do behind the scenes when you use a site cov in a detection formula.

Ken
